summary_md: **Miracast ([@MiracastAirplay](https://x.com/MiracastAirplay/status/2115826129257017381))** launches **OpenSiTerm**, which gives Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI and other coding agents direct serial-port read/write so they can read device logs and send console commands themselves ([aimachy/opensiterm](https://github.com/aimachy/opensiterm)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - aimachy/opensiterm: OpenSiTerm-Serial port access for AI coding agents.Let Claude Code, Codex, opencode, oh-my-pi, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek and other agents read your device's logs and type into its console themselves, instead of you copy-pasting serial output into the chat.

relevance: Extends coding agents to hardware debugging.
